map.每亩株数 = 666.67 ÷ (株距×行距)（m）；每公顷株数 = 每亩×15: Trees per mu = 666.67 ÷ (tree spacing × row spacing) in m²; trees per hectare = trees per mu × 15; total trees = trees per mu × area; planting cost = total trees × seedling unit price (1 mu = 666.67 m², 1 hectare = 15 mu).
Tree spacing 2 m, row spacing 3 m, planting 100 mu, 2.5 CNY per seedling: trees per mu = 666.67/(2×3) = 111.1, total trees ≈ 11111, planting cost ≈ 11111×2.5 = 27,800 CNY.
map.不同树种推荐密度一样吗？: Is the recommended density the same for all species?
map.不同。杉木约 110~167 株/亩、桉树约 80~110 株/亩，应依树种特性: No. Chinese fir is about 110-167 trees/mu and eucalyptus about 80-110 trees/mu, so adjust for species characteristics and site: too dense causes competition and too sparse wastes land.
map.实际需苗为什么要加损耗？: Why add a loss allowance to the real seedling requirement?
map.补植、死苗、分级损耗常按 5%~10% 计，规划设计需苗量应含损耗，避免造林时苗: Replanting, dead seedlings and grading losses are commonly counted at 5%-10%, and a planning design should include the allowance so seedlings do not run short at planting time.
